title: Add prominent start button as primary call-to-action

requirements.text: Add a large, prominent 'Start Coaching Session' button to the CoachingDashboard component that appears above or alongside the existing quick-start coaching topic cards, serving as a primary call-to-action for authenticated users

quotes: add a prominent start button to complement your existing quick-start coaching options

acceptanceCriteria: A visually prominent button labeled 'Start Coaching Session' or similar is visible on the coaching dashboard
The button appears in a strategic position (e.g., hero section, above quick-start cards) to draw user attention
Clicking the button initiates a new coaching session flow (e.g., opens topic selection or starts a general coaching session)
The button complements rather than replaces the existing quick-start coaching topic cards
Button styling aligns with the existing design system (theme colors, animations, accessibility)

constraints: Do not remove or replace the existing quick-start coaching topic cards in the CoachingDashboard
Maintain consistency with the existing OKLCH-based color system and theme variables
Preserve the existing authentication flow and backend actor usage patterns
nonGoals: Changing the backend API or data models
Modifying the coaching session page interface
Altering the voice recording or playback functionality
